cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-cenat-dragon-2024w34
cuts.title: Kai Cenat dies to the Ender Dragon, then beats it
cuts.hook: Kai and Speed die to the dragon
cuts.retelling: Kai and IShowSpeed both die to the Ender Dragon in Hardcore Minecraft, and four days later Kai goes back, counts down, and screams in celebration as the End credits roll.

cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-around-drench-2025w40
cuts.title: 'Still dripping': the Kai Cenat water prank, a year apart
cuts.hook: Kai gets soaked asleep on stream
cuts.retelling: Kai got soaked while asleep on stream in 2024, and a year later his crew tries the same water-bag prank on someone in Mafiathon 3, though it's unclear who or whether it works.

cuts.label: scout:ishowspeed/ishowspeed-bann-ishowspe-2025w39
cuts.title: IShowSpeed banned from the mall, pinned in a gym
cuts.hook: Speed: banned from the mall, pinned
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed gets banned from a mall, then separately gets pinned by a woman while sparring in a gym and says he almost died.
